mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or the rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in both consumer demand and manufacturing output, which triggers a negative earnings outlook and causes S&P 500 returns to fall over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline over the prior 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity multiples contract.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months reflects strong consumer demand for residential real estate, which boosts construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST increases over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the number of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below 140,000 thousand in a 3-month window, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when PAYEMS is below 140000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in manufacturing output and consumer spending, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline over the prior 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate above 2.5% annually), the economy is nearing full capacity, leading to inflationary pressures and potential central bank tightening, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5%.
